title: Uniformly bounded, uniformly α-Hölder difference quotients imply C¹ with α-Hölder derivative (Nirenberg's difference-quotient method, Hölder form)
statement: Let m ≥ 1, k ∈ ℕ, α > 0, x₀ ∈ ℝ^m, R, h₀ > 0, C ∈ ℝ, and let f : ℝ^m → L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k) be continuous on B := B_R(x₀). Assume that for every unit vector v and every t ≠ 0 with |t| < h₀ the quotient q_t(x) := t⁻¹(f(x + tv) − f(x)) satisfies ‖q_t(x)‖ ≤ C and ‖q_t(x) − q_t(y)‖ ≤ C‖x − y‖^α for all x, y ∈ B. Then f is C¹ on B, ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ C and ‖Df(x) − Df(y)‖ ≤ C‖x − y‖^α for all x, y ∈ B.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → 0 < α → ∀ (f : Euclid m → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)) (x₀ : Euclid m) (R h₀ C : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < h₀ → ContinuousOn f (ball x₀ R) → (∀ v : Euclid m, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → |t| < h₀ → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖t⁻¹ • (f (x + t • v) - f x)‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖t⁻¹ • (f (x + t • v) - f x) - t⁻¹ • (f (y + t • v) - f y)‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x₀ R) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
